title: KissFM - Nathan Evans - Wellerman (220 KID & Billen Ted Remix)

lines.l: The captain called all hands and swore, he'd take the whale in tow
Soon may the well-o-man come to bring the sugar and tea and hum
One day when the time is done, we'll take a leave and go
Soon may the well-o-man come to bring the sugar and tea and hum
